text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — we're doing a midnight firmware flip on rack-az4 GPUs (microcode + BMC) 00:30-02:00 UTC, plan is soft-reboots not full power cycles.
Josh: Who's oncall for midnight? @amanda?
Amanda: I can cover 00:15-02:30 UTC. I'll be primary, Marco backup.
Priya: Goal: zero customer-visible outage for Hosted but expect 5-10% capacity loss in eu/az4. We'll shift traffic to eu-west1 and burst to dedicated pools for tenants with reserved capacity.
Marco: Suggest pre-seeding KV cache on target pools to avoid cold-start tails.
Josh: Agree. Runbook snippet:
```bash
# pre-seed cache
bin/seed_kv_cache --model vicuna-13b --prefix /preseed/az4 --targets eu-west1,dedicated-pool-2
``` 
Priya: We'll throttle reboots by rack: 2 servers/min, pause on any latency > 2x baseline for 10m.
SRE-Bot: [AUTO] Canary check at 00:40 UTC — latency within baseline ✅
Carol (prod): Any customer comms? Want to flag to Dedicated contract holders — they'll see capacity shift.
Amanda: I'll draft short email and support blurb. Foodchain: reduce batch sizes for low-priority jobs during window.
Josh: Cost question — how much extra spot/backfill spend ballpark? Finance: ~estimated $1.2k for 2h if we keep burst nodes.
Sophie (finance): Rough calc: 60 GPUs * $2/hr * 1.0h avg = $120, plus network egress — rounding to $1.2k as buffer.
Priya: OK. We'll cap burst to 40 GPUs to keep costs < $800.
Marco: Scheduler hooks: set tenant priority for gold customers to avoid preemption. Add this to runbook:
```json
{"affinity":"gold","eviction_policy":"never-preempt"}
```
Priya: After first rack flip, do a short soak 20m, then proceed. Amanda will post updates in #status and I'll pin the runbook.
Amanda: Draft comm posted in #announcements at 00:00 UTC. Support blurb ready.
Priya: Any objections? If not we'll ship schedule and mark maintenance in calendar.
Josh: No objections from infra team. :thumbsup:
Marco: I'll start pre-seed jobs at 23:40 UTC.
Amanda: Thanks all, will follow up with a short postmortem template.
